The '''Haseria system''' was located in the [[Haserian sector/Legends|Haserian sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was connected by the [[Reena Trade Route]] to the [[Monastery system/Legends|Monastery system]] as well as the [[Druckenwell system/Legends|Druckenwell system]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The Haseria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Haserian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CNII" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Haseria system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-15.<ref name="TEA" />
